battle.name: 仙人關之戰
battle.brief: 紹興四年正月，金國都元帥完顏宗弼與完顏杲率大軍自鳳翔東下，企圖攻取蜀地。宋川陝宣撫司吳玠以數千之眾據守仙人關險隘，依山築壘，以十字弩與弓弩輪番射擊抵禦金軍攻勢，再遣精騎出壘反擊，金軍大潰，斬獲數千，攻蜀之策就此破滅。

kit.name: 十字弩
kit.history: 弩把射速交給了機械，代價是裝填慢。城牆上它比長弓可靠，野戰裡它比長弓脆弱。

countries: 紹興四年正月，交戰的雙方是南宋與金國。南宋方面，防守由趙構朝廷設在西北的川陝宣撫司系統主持，吳玠以宣撫副使兼秦鳳一路經略的權柄坐鎮鳳翔、興元之間，總制秦鳳、洮岷、階成一帶的宋軍，吳璘、楊政、曹斐等部將分隸麾下，前線兵力集中在徽縣、兩當、略陽沿嘉陵江的關隘線上，糧秣則由沔州、興元等後方轉運，金軍一旦叩關，宋軍的退路即通往四川。金國方面，由完顏氏女真貴族掌握的軍政系統發動，完顏宗弼（兀术）以河南元帥與都元帥的名號統兵，金主完顏亶在燕京以璽書催促，完顏杲以副將身分隨軍；金軍以女真、契丹、漢軍混合編制，騎兵居於打擊核心，步兵以漢軍為主，並倚仗劉豫偽齊政權在河南提供的糧秣與丁壯。所以這不是兩國全面交鋒，而是一條攻勢對一條防線的較量：吳玠所部是死守方，完顏宗弼所部是進攻方，勝負取決於關隘這一段地形能否被利用，而不是雙方總兵力的多寡。
countriesEn: The two belligerents in the first month of the Shaoxing era were Southern Song and the Jin dynasty. On the Song side the defence was run by the Chuan-Shaan circuit administration that the Zhao Gou court had set up in the northwest. Wu Jie, holding the authority of vice commissioner of pacification together with the administration of the Qinfeng circuit, sat at the hinge between Fengxiang and Xingyuan and controlled the Song troops in the Qinfeng, Taomin and Jiecheng areas. Wu Lin, Yang Zheng and Cao Fei led the various detachments under him; the forward force was concentrated on the chain of passes along the Jialing River around Huixian, Liangdang and Lueyang, while grain and fodder were shifted forward from the rear areas of Hanzhong and Xingyuan, so that once the Jin knocked on the passes the Song road of retreat ran straight into Sichuan. On the Jin side the campaign was directed by the military government of the Wanyan clan. Wanyan Zongbi (Wuzhu) led the host with the titles of prince and commander-in-chief of the Henan circuit, the Jin ruler Wanyan Dan sat in Yanjing urging him forward by imperial rescript, and Wanyan Gao marched as the second in command. The Jin host mixed Jurchen, Khitan and Chinese units, with cavalry as the striking core and Chinese troops forming the infantry, and it drew grain, fodder and conscript labour from the puppet Qi state of Liu Yu in Henan. The fighting was therefore not a general war between two states but the test of one offensive thrust against one line of passes: Wu Jie's men were the side that held, Wanyan Zongbi's men the side that attacked, and the outcome depended on whether that stretch of country could be turned to advantage rather than on the relative size of the two armies.
people: 吳玠（1093—1141），字晉卿，綏德軍人，是這場戰役的宋方主帥。建炎以來他收拾散在關中的西軍殘部，重整軍紀，把廢棄的和尚原、仙人關一線重新築壘設防，1131年已在和尚原大破完顏宗弼，此次再以孤軍擋住金軍主力的進攻。吳玠之弟吳璘為右護軍統制，是宋軍陣中最兇悍的衝鋒指揮，屢次率敢死隊出壘破陣；楊政、曹斐等分領各隊，負責側翼警戒與糧道防守，熙河方向的王武等部作為策應。宋方還有熟悉關山地形的蕃兵與歸附的西軍老卒，憑熟悉道路與冬令氣候襄助守壘。金方主將完顏宗弼（兀术，1103—1150）是金太祖完顏阿骨打之弟，與其子完顏亮同父的猛將，此次以都元帥身分率大軍入隴，志在重演滅遼時的長驅直入；完顏杲為金宗室、封沈王，隨軍為副將；金主完顏亶坐鎮燕京，以璽書督戰，並令劉豫的偽齊在河南供應糧草、派齊軍隨金軍行動。完顏宗弼性烈而少謀，此役正是其成名之戰，也是其一生最重的挫敗之一。
peopleEn: Wu Jie (1093-1141), courtesy name Jinqing, a native of Suide prefecture, was the Song commander of the field. Since the Jianyou era he had gathered the scattered survivors of the western army in Guanzhong, restored their discipline, and rebuilt the line of forts and passes around Heshangyuan and Xianren Pass that had been abandoned. Having already beaten Wanyan Zongbi at Heshangyuan in 1131, he now held off the main body of the Jin army with a force of a few thousand. His younger brother Wu Lin, commander of the Right Guard Army, was the fiercest assault leader in the Song ranks and repeatedly took the vanguard out of the fort to break the enemy. Yang Zheng, Cao Fei and others commanded separate detachments responsible for the flanks and for guarding the supply line, with troops such as Wang Wu from the Xihe direction held in reserve. The Song also had the help of local tribal troops and of old soldiers of the western army who knew the roads of the passes and the winter climate of the region. The Jin commander Wanyan Zongbi (Wuzhu, 1103-1150) was a fierce general and brother of the founder Wanyan Aguda, father of the later emperor Wanyan Liang; he entered Longnan as commander-in-chief in the hope of repeating the long thrust that had destroyed the Liao. Wanyan Gao, a member of the imperial clan with the title Prince of Shen, marched as his deputy, and the Jin ruler Wanyan Dan remained at Yanjing pressing the advance with rescripts and ordering Liu Yu's puppet Qi to supply grain in Henan and to send Qi troops forward with the Jin columns. Wanyan Zongbi was hot-tempered and short of cunning; this battle was his famous victory and also one of the heaviest checks of his life.
kits: 本份檔案的主體兵器是十字弩，即以木製弩臂、機關與鋼矢構成的弩，屬宋軍步卒與守壘部隊的標準配備。吳玠在仙人關的部署裡，弩手分列於壘栅之前與坡坎之上，以機械絞弦蓄力，瞄準比長弓容易，射線平直，在低能見度與連續消耗中可以維持穩定的射速；缺點是裝填緩慢，一發之後必須退到柵後重新上弦，必須靠交替掩體與輪番射擊配合，否則弩手會在金軍接近時陷入空白。同一壘內配置的其他兵器包括角弓與複合弓、蹶張弓與神臂弓一類的重弓（射程可達二百步）、長槍、大刀、錘斧、標牌、藤牌，以及拒馬、鐵蒺藜等障礙物，壘後備有投石與成袋的箭矢，柵前還布設了削尖的鹿角與陷坑，用以遲滯騎兵衝鋒。金軍方面，完顏宗弼的騎兵普遍披掛札甲，人馬都備弓，靠騎射與衝擊力壓制壘前障礙；步兵攜帶大盾、拒馬與同樣數量的弩，攻壘時以撞竿、盾陣與密集箭雨互相掩護，攻城則依賴隨軍攜帶的粗重箭矢以射穿壘柵，並有工匠、輔兵隨行造炮修路。馬匹是兩軍最吃緊的物資，吳玠部在隴南就地徵集與轉運，供給始終不足，金軍遠道而來則靠沿途徵發的馬匹與龐大輜重隊維持。
kitsEn: The weapon at the centre of this dossier is the crossbow, built from a wooden stock, a trigger mechanism and steel bolts, and it was standard equipment of Song infantry and of the garrisons that held passes. In Wu Jie's deployment at Xianren Pass the crossbowmen were posted in front of the palisade and along the terraces of the slope above it. Mechanical cocking stored the tension in the machine and made aiming far easier than with a bow, and the bolt flew on a flat line, so the weapon kept a steady rate of fire in poor light and in the grinding exchange of an attritional defence. The price was slow loading: once a machine had been fired it had to be withdrawn behind the fence and restrung, so alternating cover and relief by rotation were indispensable, otherwise the crossbow line would go blind at the moment the enemy closed. The same fort held other weapons as well: angular and composite bows, heavy tension bows of the Treader and Shenfu type with a range of up to two hundred paces, spears, sabres, maces and axes, plain shields and rattan shields, and obstacles such as cheval-de-frise and caltrops. Stone-throwers and bags of arrows waited in the rear, while sharpened stakes and pits were set in front of the palisade to slow the charging cavalry. The Jin were equipped differently. Wanyan Zongbi's cavalry generally wore lamellar armour, both horse and rider carried a bow, and they relied on mounted archery and the weight of the charge to crush the obstacles in front of the fort. Their infantry carried large shields, cheval-de-frise and crossbows of their own, covering the assault with battering poles, shield walls and dense arrow-fall, and against fortifications they depended on heavy bolts carried in the train to punch through the palisade, with engineers and pioneers marching with the army. Horses were the tightest commodity on both sides: Wu Jie's men gathered and shifted animals locally in Longnan and the supply was always short, while the Jin, coming from far away, lived on horses collected along the road and on enormous baggage trains.
tactics: 吳玠的戰法可以歸納為守險、蓄勢、反擊三步。他不在關前平地與金軍爭鋒，而是把主力退入仙人關一側的坡地，依山築起壘栅，壘外掘壕、削壁、列拒馬，把地勢落差變成射擊與衝力的加成。金軍每次強攻，壘內即以弩、弓、箭雨居高覆蓋，弩手分作兩隊交替上弦射擊，前隊射罄退入柵後，後隊補上射位，士卒全程不與金兵接觸，只以投射物消耗其人馬與陣形；如此數日，金軍攻勢由盛轉衰，士氣與體力都被磨掉，屢次硬攻造成的死傷與墜馬成了宋軍的積蓄。宋軍同時以少量精騎在壘側巡邏，截擊金軍散兵與輜重隊，切斷其接濟。待金軍主力再攻、陣形鬆動之際，吳玠下令全軍出壘：以吳璘所部為先鋒，步卒繼以標牌長槍壓上，騎兵隨後掩殺，直衝金軍中軍；金軍久攻疲憊而無後援，陣形被衝破，潰兵互相踐踏，宋軍乘勢追擊直趨河谷，奪其甲兵、馬匹、糧秣與輜重。宋軍沒有追得太遠，因隆冬山地積雪、糧秣告急，收兵回壘固守。金軍退保渭水、鳳翔一線，短期內再無力叩關，川陝邊界重新陷入對峙。
tacticsEn: Wu Jie's method can be reduced to three steps: hold the ground, husband the enemy's strength, then counter-attack. He did not offer battle with the Jin on the open ground before the pass. Instead he drew the main force up the slope on one side of Xianren Pass, built a palisaded fort against the mountain, dug a ditch, cut the rock face and set cheval-de-frise along the approaches, so that the height of the ground was converted into an addition to both shooting range and shock. Whenever the Jin attacked in earnest, the fort answered from above with crossbows, bows and a rain of arrows. The crossbowmen were divided into two teams that cocked in rotation: the first team fired until its machines were empty and withdrew behind the palisade, the second moving up into the vacated shooting slots. The troops never closed with the Jin and spent the enemy's men, horses and formation with nothing but missiles. In this way, over several days, the Jin assault went from strength to exhaustion, and their morale and stamina with it, the dead and the horses thrown by the repeated attacks turning into the Song's reserves. At the same time small bodies of Song cavalry patrolled the flanks of the fort, cut off stragglers and baggage trains and severed the enemy's support. When the Jin came on again and their formation loosened, Wu Jie ordered the whole force out of the fort. Wu Lin's command led as the vanguard, spearmen and shield-bearers pressed forward behind them, and the cavalry followed to cut down the fugitives. The Jin, worn out by days of assault and without support, had their formation broken, the routed columns ran into one another, and the Song pursued them as far as the river valley, taking their armour, horses, grain and baggage. The Song did not press the pursuit far, for the winter snow on the mountain roads made supplies urgent, and the army returned to the fort and held. The Jin withdrew to the line of the Wei River and Fengxiang, and for a time had no strength to knock on the pass again; the Shaan-Sichuan frontier settled back into a stalemate.
data: 時間：南宋紹興四年（1134）正月，時值隆冬，關中與隴南山地積雪，道路泥濘，糧秣轉運遲滯。地名：戰場在今甘肅省隴南市徽縣東的嘉陵江河谷，關城距徽縣城約數十里，東接陝西略陽，關外西行二百餘公里即達鳳翔府，是金軍東南下與宋軍西援之間的鎖鑰。距離：徽縣至鳳翔約二百公里，關外即金軍糧道與退路；宋軍後方興元、沔州距前線亦約三百公里，中間靠沿嘉陵江與渭河的接力轉運維持。兵力：金軍總數宋方奏報稱十萬，吳玠估計在五萬以上，實際投入關前進攻的數目無可靠統計；宋軍在關上只三千餘至五千人，交戰自攻壘至潰敗持續數日，壘前攻防反覆。金軍屢攻不得入，死傷、墜馬與散失器械甚多，宋軍斬獲首級數千級，奪馬數千匹，收繳甲兵、弩弓、旗鼓、糧秣與輜重以萬計，俘獲金軍將士甚眾。宋軍方面的損失，史料未留下可信的數目，只知出壘反擊與追擊階段有相當傷亡，多為精騎與步卒在近身搏鬥中所折。
dataEn: Timing: the first month of the fourth year of Shaoxing (1134), in the depth of winter, with snow lying on the passes of Guanzhong and Longnan, muddy roads and slow grain convoys. Place: the battlefield lay in the Jialing River valley east of Huixian in today's Longnan prefecture of Gansu. The fort stood some tens of li from the county seat of Huixian, adjoined Lueyang in Shaanxi to the east, and about two hundred kilometres to the west lay Fengxiang fu, the hinge between the Jin march down from the east and the Song reinforcements coming from the west. Distances: some two hundred kilometres separate Huixian from Fengxiang, and the ground beyond the pass was the Jin supply road and their line of retreat; the Song rear at Xingyuan and Hanzhong stood about three hundred kilometres from the front, with relay transport along the Jialing and the Wei bridging the gap. Numbers: the Song reported the Jin host at a hundred thousand and Wu Jie estimated more than fifty thousand, but no reliable count exists for the troops actually engaged before the pass; the Song force on the pass numbered only three to five thousand, and the fighting, from the first assault to the collapse of the Jin, ran for several days of repeated attempts on the fort. The Jin failed to take it and lost heavily in dead, in horses thrown and in abandoned equipment; the Song claimed several thousand heads taken, several thousand horses captured, and armour, crossbows, bows, banners, drums, grain and baggage seized in tens of thousands of pieces, with many Jin soldiers taken prisoner. No trustworthy figure survives for Song losses; it is known only that there were considerable casualties during the sortie and the pursuit, mostly among the cavalry and the foot soldiers caught in close fighting.
cause: 金軍攻關並非偶然。金自靖康二年（1127）滅北宋後，重心放在黃河與江淮，卻始終未能打通連接西北與蜀中的通道。蜀地糧鹽茶鐵齊備，關中又產馬，控有川陝便等於掐住南宋的西線補給與上游屏障；完顏宗弼在和尚原受挫之後仍不肯罷手，1133年冬集兵於河南與關中，擬乘宋軍新敗、人心未定的空檔，自鳳翔沿渭水東下，擊破關陝防線，取漢中、興元，進逼成都。這與劉豫偽齊在中原的攻勢互相策應：西路一破，金軍便可從襄漢與江淮兩面同時向南宋施壓。對宋方而言，吳玠麾下不過是靖康之難後從關中零散收攏的西軍殘部，缺馬、缺糧、缺甲，士卒多為潰兵與降眾，關陝能否守住，關係到南宋能否在四川與荊湖之間維持一條可用的戰略通道。吳玠正是靠這支部隊的整肅與關隘的險固，把金軍的進攻擋在了秦嶺與嘉陵江之間。
causeEn: The Jin assault on the pass was not a sudden decision. After the destruction of Northern Song in 1127 Jin had thrown its weight towards the Yellow River and the Huai, yet it never managed to open a corridor between the northwest and Sichuan. Sichuan supplied grain, salt, tea and iron, and Guanzhong bred horses, so that holding the Shaan-Sichuan passes was the same as pinching the western lifeline of Southern Song and its shield in the upper reaches. Wanyan Zongbi, checked at Heshangyuan, would not give up: in the winter of 1133 he mustered troops in Henan and Guanzhong, hoping to take advantage of a Song army still disordered after its defeats and short of confidence, push down along the Wei River from Fengxiang, break the Shaanxi-Sichuan line, take Hanzhong and Xingyuan and press on to Chengdu. The movement was meant to work together with Liu Yu's puppet Qi offensive in the central plain: if the western road fell, Jin could press Southern Song from two directions at once, through Xiangyang-Han in the west and across the Huai in the east. On the Song side, Wu Jie's command was nothing more than the scattered remnants of the western army gathered in Guanzhong since the Jingkang disaster, short of horses, of grain and of armour, the soldiers largely deserters and surrendered men. Whether the Shaan-Sichuan line could be held decided whether Southern Song kept a usable strategic corridor between Sichuan and the Jinghu region. It was by putting that force back in order and by the sheer difficulty of the passes that Wu Jie managed to hold the Jin advance between the Qinling range and the Jialing River.
impact: 仙人關之勝是紹興初年南宋西部戰局最要緊的轉折。金軍攻蜀受挫，被迫放棄正面突破川陝，改為迂迴南下，轉攻襄漢與江淮，於是才有1140年前後順昌、采石一役中金軍再遭挫敗的結局；換言之，吳玠在隴南的一場勝利，把金軍的進攻軸線往東推了數百里，為南宋兩淮防線爭取到喘息的時間。宋廷自此更加倚重川陝，以吳玠進位、加賜爵秩，並在秦鳳、洮岷、階成一線設軍、置屯、築城，關外堡寨的經營成為長期政策。影響的另一面則是朝廷對吳玠的猜忌與控制：其功越大，朝中議和派越忌憚，糧餉與兵源屢被掣肘，1135年前後吳玠被迫放棄關外部分據點，退守興元一線，關隘的縱深因此變薄。吳玠本人在1141年病逝，部眾歸吳璘，西軍作為南宋西北柱石的傳統延續了下去；而這場以弩壘與騎兵反擊取勝的戰役，也成了後世兵書講究據險待敵、以逸待勞的典型案例。
impactEn: The victory at Xianren Pass was the most important turning point in the western war of the early Shaoxing years. The Jin attack on Sichuan failed; the frontal attempt on the Shaan-Sichuan line had to be abandoned in favour of a roundabout advance to the south, and the campaign was turned towards Xiangyang-Han and the Huai, which is why the Jin met further checks around Shunchang and Caishi in 1140. In other words, a single battle won by Wu Jie in Longnan pushed the axis of Jin attack several hundred kilometres to the east and bought the Song defensive line on the Huai the time it needed. The court now relied on the Shaan-Sichuan front even more: Wu Jie was advanced in rank and granted noble titles, garrisons, depots and forts were established along the Qinfeng, Taomin and Jiecheng lines, and the upkeep of forts beyond the frontier became a long-term policy of the war. The other face of that influence was the court's suspicion and control of Wu Jie himself. The greater his standing, the more the peace party at court feared him, and his supplies and replacements were repeatedly held back; around 1135 he was forced to give up positions outside the passes and fall back to the Xingyuan line, thinning the depth of the frontier. Wu Jie died of illness in 1141 and his troops passed to Wu Lin, so that the tradition of the western army as a pillar of the northwest survived. This battle, won with a crossbow fort and a cavalry counter-stroke, also became a standard case in later military writing for holding ground by advantage of situation and letting the enemy exhaust himself before the counter-attack.
result: 宋軍大勝，金軍大敗。完顏宗弼與完顏杲在關前攻勢耗盡、又遭宋軍出壘反擊與騎兵掩殺之後，退回渭水、鳳翔方向，金人短期內再無攻蜀之師。宋軍在關下及退兵路上斬獲數千，奪取馬匹數千，繳獲甲兵、弩弓、旗鼓、糧秣與輜重以萬計，俘獲將士甚眾，吳玠乘勝收復祁山一線堡寨，進而向寶雞、鳳翔方向威逼，川陝的門戶重新回到宋軍掌握。金軍元氣大傷，無力再組織像樣的關隴攻勢，宋金在西北的邊界此後數年相對安定，宋軍得以把重心轉回襄漢、兩淮與江上的防禦。回頭看，這場戰役的勝負不在雙方總兵力，而在守方怎麼用地形、怎麼分配弩手與弓手的射擊輪次、什麼時候把精騎放出去：吳玠的答案是先守後攻，把金軍的銳氣在壘前耗盡，再以一次出壘反擊收掉全場。
resultEn: The Song won decisively and the Jin lost heavily. Wanyan Zongbi and Wanyan Gao, their assault spent in front of the fort and then caught by the Song sortie and the cavalry charge, withdrew towards the Wei River and Fengxiang, and for the time being the Jin abandoned the plan of taking Sichuan. The Song took several thousand men below the pass and on the retreat, captured several thousand horses, and seized armour, crossbows, bows, banners, drums, grain and baggage in tens of thousands of pieces, with many officers and soldiers taken prisoner. Wu Jie pressed the advantage to recover the line of forts at Qishan and threatened onwards towards Baoji and Fengxiang, and the gateway of Shaanxi and Sichuan returned to Song hands. The Jin were badly shaken and could no longer organise a serious offensive against the Guanzhong passes; the frontier in the northwest was comparatively quiet for several years, and the Song could turn their attention back to Xiangyang-Han, the Huai and the river defences. Looking back, the outcome of this battle turned not on the relative size of the two armies but on how the defenders used the ground, how they divided the shooting shifts of crossbow and bow, and when they released the cavalry. Wu Jie's answer was to defend first, grind the Jin's momentum away in front of the fort, and then close the whole field with a single counter-stroke out of the walls.
